description: NaLi₃Ti₂Cr₂(PO₄)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.40 Å) and three longer (2.57 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CrO₆ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-71°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.13 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent LiO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are three shorter (1.88 Å) and three longer (2.09 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and three longer (1.98 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent LiO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are three shorter (1.95 Å) and three longer (2.07 Å) Cr-O bond lengths. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three equivalent LiO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are three shorter (1.98 Å) and three longer (2.06 Å) Cr-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two CrO₆ octahedra, and corners with three equivalent LiO₄ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-47°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two CrO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-43°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.56 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Li, one Cr, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Cr, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cr and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li, one Cr, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Li, one Ti, and one P atom.
